rule: One property sheet per Autobot identifier (D-22, in T-10's shape). Two grammars: minted ids are `<prefix>_<32 lowercase hex>` (128 random bits from the owning seat's CSPRNG); name ids are slugs `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$`. Equality is exact byte equality; only the canonical spelling is valid; identifiers are immutable, never reused, and no event changes one. PrincipalRef is registered separately (D-40): `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$`, must be a principals.json id.

identifiers.name: task_contract_id
identifiers.lifecycle: one per contract lineage; a revision keeps it; supersession mints a new record that may keep or change it as the superseding payload states

identifiers.name: sequence_id
identifiers.minted_at: Sequence creation (lifecycle coupling to the record, INV-40)
identifiers.lifecycle: one per Sequence, forever; a duplicate admission creates none

identifiers.name: attempt_id
identifiers.lifecycle: one per attempt; fencing terminates the attempt, never renames it

identifiers.name: reservation_id
identifiers.minted_at: reservation rows (t-s15a/b, t-s21, t-s29, t-s31, t-s32)
identifiers.lifecycle: RESERVED to CONSUMED or RELEASED exactly once (INV-42); a fresh reservation is a new id

identifiers.name: intent_id
identifiers.minted_at: every transition or rule minting obj-25 (t-s15a/b, t-s21, t-s31, t-s32, t-i06, t-g01, t-w01)
identifiers.lifecycle: terminal states end it; a retry mints a new intent that binds the superseded one's id (CORR-56)

identifiers.name: registration_id
identifiers.minted_at: registration of a verifier or transform version
identifiers.lifecycle: one per registered version; a new version is a new registration_id; never unregistered, only superseded

identifiers.name: delegation_id
identifiers.derivation: random-128 at first mint; every later record of the same delegation carries the same value
identifiers.lifecycle: names the delegation lineage across its records; in a TaskContractRecord it is a consistency-constrained copy of the bound record's value (D-44)

identifiers.name: duplicate_admission_id
identifiers.lifecycle: append-only journal fact; never referenced by hash in v1 (referenced by id)

identifiers.name: environment_id
identifiers.lifecycle: one per probe run; receipts reference the obj-18 object hash, the id is the ledger handle

identifiers.name: legacy_id
identifiers.lifecycle: ledger handle; identity is the source bytes' content address (D-48)

identifiers.name: verifier_id
identifiers.lifecycle: stable across versions; version-to-registration resolution happens at freeze (K-3)

identifiers.name: transform_id
identifiers.lifecycle: stable across versions; resolution at freeze (K-2)

identifiers.name: repository_id
identifiers.lifecycle: stable for the repository; a rename is a new declaration (D-23)

identifiers.name: assertion_id
identifiers.lifecycle: immutable inside the frozen record; referenced externally as record_hash + part selector (D-47)

identifiers.name: edge_id
identifiers.lifecycle: immutable inside the frozen record; the predecessors set sorts by it; referenced as record_hash + part selector (D-47)

identifiers.name: role
identifiers.lifecycle: map key of role_transforms and completion_policies; the ROLE_TRANSFORM part selector

identifiers.name: input_name
identifiers.derivation: author-chosen name of a specification input
